title: Otori Emu — Time For A Strategy Meeting!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We haven't visited Miku in such a long time!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. We've been too busy making preparations for our own performances lately to drop by.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But they've helped us out a lot, so it's only right that we update them properly on what's been happening lately!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I wonder how everyone's doing?
And where are they, anyway?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Probably near the stage?
Let's go look for...hm?

rows.Speaker: Miku Costume
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ah! It's a Miku mascot costume!
And it's so cute!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That costume... Miku, you're inside, right?
You scared me the other day, but I won't fall for the same antic twice!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Take off that costume and come on out, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm over here☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nowaaargh?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow, wow! Hi, Miku! Huh?
Then who's in the mascot costume?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hehe, sorry for the scare.
It was me!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You should never disappoint your guests by surprising them with the same trick twice.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
It's KAITO!
Hi, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hello. It's been a while, hasn't it?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ugh, I can't believe I fell for it hook, line, and sinker...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But it's good to see you again after so long, Miku, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe, same here!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Long time no see, Miku!
Okay, so, the four of us have been performing on stage together after that day!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Nice!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And we included the song we sang here in our shows too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We put the song into the jingle-jangle part of the ending so it's now more of a ba-ba-ba-bam! instead. And everyone in the audience went like Whoa... when they saw that!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Our show was a huge success!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I can see why! Congrats!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Um... I'm sorry, but what did she just say?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: By replacing the usual BGM in the last part of the program with a song, we were able to allow the audience to bask in the afterglow of the performance for a longer time.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And the audience gave us a standing ovation for that. That's probably what she meant. A very big probably.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, I get it now...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We tried to do a lalalalaaa the other day for our performance too♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And then everyone was like buzz-buzz-WHEE! and that made the whole thing super fun☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That's so nice!
I wish I could've been there too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And what is SHE saying?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well, we sang together with the audience in the last show.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Everyone loved it and had a real blast because of that... Or at least, that's what I think she was trying to say.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, clearly... How can you even tell?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Looks like we both need to work on our communication...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
By the way! We're gonna have a show later!
Do you wanna join us?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wuh?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wh-What did you say?! To be able to perform on the same stage as Miku herself is an honor beyond comprehension!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That was what Tsukasa actually wanted to say!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, don't just dub over me like that!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So says Tsukasa as his heart swells with happy anticipation.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Switching to a narrative voice doesn't make it more okay!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Good gracious...
Well, if we're doing this, we might as well ask Rui and Nene to join us too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup yup!
Let's all join in the fun together☆
